name: Saturated
author: Uploader
short_desc: Saturated is a resourcepack that makes the game look more vibrant
description:
Saturated is a Resource Pack for Minecraft Bedrock Edition that makes the game look slightly more vibrant!

This pack is also available for Java Edition.

All types of textures are more vibrant including:

    - GUIs
    - Items
    - Blocks
    - Entities
